violations.reason: The core client requirement to fix HTTP 401 errors on endpoints that must answer 200/201 is entirely unaddressed by the provided codebase and merged PRs.
The coverage audit report falsely claims zero gaps for the Moodle Integration, despite missing core client requirements such as SSO authentication, role hierarchy mapping, and autonomous fallback.
The review verdict acts as a pipeline stage faking success by approving a non-existent PR (f6bd873c-a54a-4592-a928-5fc73e23d6b6) with an empty reason.
The PR claims to implement Strain Management API CRUD endpoints, but only adds an OpenAPI contract (StrainManagement.openapi.yaml) with no actual backend code wiring.
The review verdict recorded 'block', violating the BARCAN-TAG-00 charter which mandates binary verdicts of APPROVE or REJECT.
